result.summary: The page looks generally well-designed with no critical visual defects. Minor issues include a truncated restaurant name, notification badge accessibility, and horizontal carousel cards being cut off at the screen edge.

issues.description: The third restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, and its card is cut off at the screen edge, which may reduce discoverability.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card width and text ellipsis behavior are intentional; consider showing a subtle peek of the next card or full name wrapping to two lines.

issues.description: The notification bell uses only a small red dot to indicate unread notifications, with no text alternative; color-only and tiny-dot indicators can be missed and are inaccessible to screen readers.
issues.suggestion: Add a badge count or descriptive content description/aria-label for the notification button.

issues.description: The promo banner's decorative circle overlays slightly obscure the 'Use code TALLINN3' text area, potentially reducing readability of the promo code.
issues.suggestion: Increase contrast or reposition decorative elements so promo code text remains fully legible.
